fullGoalSnapshot.title: Metallrecycling für Konsum- und Entsorgungsentscheidungen nutzen
fullGoalSnapshot.titleEn: Use metal recycling knowledge for consumption and disposal decisions
fullGoalSnapshot.description: Die lernende Person kann die Bedeutung des Metallrecyclings für Ressourcenschonung und Energieeinsparung beschreiben und auf dieser Grundlage das eigene Konsum- und Entsorgungsverhalten begründet bewerten.
fullGoalSnapshot.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the significance of metal recycling for conserving resources and saving energy and use that account to assess their own consumption and disposal choices with reasons.

goalPayloadHashDefinition: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sorted object keys, separators comma and colon; goal payload before proposed resourceLink

referenceStrategy.strategy: Friendly comic language described in prompt; no copied existing image or layout.

selectedScientificExample: Aluminium: primary route from bauxite through omitted alumina/electrolytic stages versus collected aluminium scrap through omitted sorting/remelting/refining stages, comparable ingot output.
selectionReason: USGS supports the bauxite/alumina/aluminium primary chain; UBA supports energy input for every recycling route, substantially lower production energy for secondary aluminium and resource conservation. Aluminium therefore permits a bounded same-metal comparison instead of generic metal claims.

proposedResourceLink.title: Visualisierung: Metallrecycling für Konsum- und Entsorgungsentscheidungen nutzen
proposedResourceLink.description: Aluminium: Rohstoffe und Energie vergleichen, länger nutzen und getrennt zurückgeben.
proposedResourceLink.altText: Zwei vereinfachte Aluminiumwege liefern gleich dargestellte Metallbarren: oben Bauxit mit größerem Energiebedarf, unten gesammeltes Altmetall mit geringerem, aber sichtbarem Energiebedarf. Rechts betrachtet eine Person eine Metalltrinkflasche. Getrennte Symbole zeigen längere Nutzung der intakten Flasche und spätere getrennte Rückgabe am Nutzungsende.

authorActualInspection.native: Two equally oriented routes lead to comparable same-shape aluminium ingots. Top bauxite is replaced by collected scrap below; both plants have visible energy bolts. The longer-use cue around an intact bottle is separate from the end-of-life return cue. No home recycling mechanism or assessment appears.
authorActualInspection.phone360: Main routes, bauxite/scrap contrast, equal ingots and the person with bottle remain clear. The energy contrast is legible with larger/smaller bolt cues. Länger nutzen/Getrennt zurückgeben are smaller (two-line labels) but recognizable; alt text supplies the full personal-choice account.
authorActualInspection.card680: All route and personal-choice labels are legible; no crop required.
authorActualInspection.styleAndPerspective: Friendly comic person and objects, coherent pale-blue/orange/teal palette. The bottle is held normally; no written page, instrument or falsely oriented learner work surface.
authorActualInspection.remainingRisks: The count of energy bolts is symbolic, not a 3:1 energy measurement. The lower label says Altmetall under the aluminium example heading; drawn can/profile offcuts are intended to be aluminium, not proof that mixed-metal scrap directly becomes pure aluminium. Plants are overview symbols with sorting/refining/electrolysis stages omitted. The reusable bottle is an illustrative aluminium product, not a universal lifecycle recommendation.
